scope: Prospective, predeclared development on one adaptively selected head; fresh targets, no unique mechanism identification or untouched-head claim.

sampling.phase_meaning: Existing input hash partition only; this round remains prospective mechanism development. No earlier sealed outcome files are opened.
sampling.sampling: With replacement across families, with distinct donor prefixes within each role/cell and disjoint calibration/target prefix roles.
sampling.historical_exclusions: All prior prepared full strings, including unmeasured screen_transfer_003 inputs, and both20/28 prefixes across roles.

screen.rule: m<8 in both fp32 and fp64
screen.selection: First256 accepted in fixed candidate order; finish all2048 before selecting.
screen.shortfall: insufficient_screening_yield; no calibration, replenishment, cutoff change or replacement

intervention.recipient_site: highest native fp64 EOS attention on a closing bracket; first tie

predictions.target_scoring: Maximum absolute prediction error over all8 fresh targets per family
predictions.receipt: All candidate forecasts in both dtypes saved and hashed before any target transfer

target_start.separation: max_target(abs(balance_average-position_average))>.202; dtype label agreement and gap discrepancy<=.001
target_start.scope: After all8calibration transfers per family, before anytarget. Ifpassed measure all256 families, not just separating subset.
target_start.failure: insufficient_design_yield; retain all calibration records and do not measure targets or add families

inference.adequacy_population: Families satisfying the frozen averaged-forecast separation criterion
inference.candidate_bounds: Clopper-Pearson lower from definite hits; upper from possible hits; each tail alpha=.01 for each of2 averaged candidates
inference.paired_test: one-sided exact paired McNemar/binomial discordant test on ALL256families
inference.paired_gain: averaged definitehit and single4 not possiblehit
inference.paired_loss: averaged not definitehit and single4 possiblehit
inference.planning_effect_note: +10pp is a planning alternative, not the null or a threshold silently tested by a significance result.
inference.same_cell_witness: Per-cell >.202 in both dtypes gives definite witness; either dtype gives possible witness; threshold disagreement is descriptive numerical uncertainty, not a main-test stop. Report counts/cases without an additional population test.
inference.legacy_comparator: Descriptive only; not the averaging test

future_confirmation_start.meaning: Feasibility only. Passing does not establish population90%adequacy or identify a mechanism; report the separate CP decision.

descriptive_amendment_002.receipt: descriptive_forecasts.jsonl hashed in forecast_receipt.json before any target
descriptive_amendment_002.decomposition: Within each family: balance, position, interaction and within-cell sums of squares on all16calibration+target margins; preserve role means, cell SDs/ranges and simple contrasts.
descriptive_amendment_002.inference: Descriptive only; no added hypothesis test, adequacy claim, error allocation, selection, start rule or future confirmation permission.
descriptive_amendment_002.precision: Both dtypes reported; C_cell signed-error discrepancy >.001 is unresolved supplemental classification, not a new primary stop.
descriptive_amendment_002.old_data_review: review/recount.json; old-data sensitivity only, not a validated forecast of the new two-calibration/two-target design.
